summary.request: Sales orders get a Packing Note on each line and an Export Status on the header that our EDI job sets once the invoice is sent. Both must be on posted invoices. When users copy documents, restore an archived order version, or cancel/correct a posted invoice, the packing notes must come along but the credit memo must not appear as already exported.
summary.business-process: Sales order processing and posting, including Copy Document, sales document archiving/restore and Cancel/Correct of posted sales invoices

objects.purpose: Named states of the EDI export of one document, starting with 'Not Exported' (ordinal 0, the value a new or copied document must have) and 'Exported'. New values are only ever appended at the end.

Source of Export Status for the TransferFields cascade to posted headers and the archive. Export Status is per-document state, not business data, so it is reset whenever a header is created by Copy Document (including Cancel and Correct).

open-questions.question: Which object/field ID range applies, and what maximum length does Packing Note need? The same number, type and length must be used on every mirrored table.
Which Export Status values does the EDI job need besides Not Exported and Exported (for example a failure state), and should the enum be extensible?
Do posted shipments and return receipts need Export Status? The mirroring rule includes every posted header unless you exclude a document type.
Does the EDI job also send posted credit memos and set their Export Status? This decides whether it needs indirect modify on Sales Cr.Memo Header.
Is the EDI job part of this app or another one? The permission design and the status-write path depend on it.
Invoices posted and sent before installation will read Export Status Not Exported (ordinal 0). Should they be backfilled as Exported, and from which source?
Is Packing Note ever defaulted from customer or item? If so, restoring an archive overwrites it during revalidation and subscribers to OnAfterTransferFromArchToSalesHeader/Line are needed.
When an archived order version is restored, should the archived Export Status be kept or reset to Not Exported?
Must Packing Note appear on posted prepayment invoice lines? That needs the field on Prepayment Inv. Line Buffer and works only with Compress Prepayment off.
Which pages must show the fields (order header, posted shipment, archive pages, lists)? The design covers the order subform and posted invoice and credit memo pages.
Are purchase documents out of scope? The design covers sales only; the copy events have purchase counterparts.
